reviews.text:
I requested information about leaving my bunny at her daycare, and she was wonderful, lovely, and provided us with absolutely all the necessary information. She's a true professional!
Congratulations, Virginia, you're fantastic!
Thank you for taking care of our 🐇 and keeping us informed at all times. …

We left our guinea pigs Napo and Fofi with Virginia for about 5 days and everything went very smoothly. She sent us photos and kept in daily contact. Our pets came back calm and collected! We're very happy with her service ;)

Virginia has been taking care of Rudolf, our bunny, for several years now. She's completely trustworthy and has a real way with animals. Our little bunny always comes home happy, and we're delighted to leave him with her.
We are very grateful for how well she has taken care of our guinea pigs in the summer, highly recommended.
This is the first time I've left my bunny with Virginia, and there will certainly be many more. She was very well cared for. Thank you, Virginia.

I have nothing but praise for Virginia. We left our two bunnies, Boli and Luna, with her, and they were incredibly well cared for during our 10-day absence. She kept us updated on their condition every single day. She will definitely be our go-to person from now on. Thank you for taking such good care of them with so much love ☺️
I was absolutely delighted with Virginia's care for Kira, my bunny. She was always in touch to keep us updated on Kira's well-being and even sent us several photos. Excellent professional service.
